page.overview:
Who is Cloud of Darkness?

The Cloud of Darkness is a powerful voidsent in Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn. She appears in the Crystal Tower storyline as a disembodied voice speaking from the World of Darkness and later appears as the final boss of the storyline.

Long ago, the resurrected Emperor Xande of the Allagan Empire forged a pact with the Cloud of Darkness to reduce Eorzea into nothingness, having realized one's achievements will be meaningless upon death. Though Xande died at the hands of the Warriors of Light, the pact remained.

Doga and Unei attempted to negate it and close the portal leading to the World of Darkness, but the Cloud of Darkness resisted and summoned Doga and Unei Clones to attack the NOAH group, pulling Doga and Unei into its world.

As the Cloud of Darkness could not harm Doga and Unei directly as they possessed Xande's blood, it resolved to use the other voidsent to kill them. Having been inadvertently dragged in by the Cloud of Darkness, Nero tol Scaeva protected the two while allowing the void to enter his body. The Warrior of Light and G'raha Tia found the Cloud of Darkness and reduced it into a formless cloud as it made a final attempt to stop the Warrior's group from escaping the World of Darkness, only to learn G'raha is a descendant of Xande's blood and thus powerless to harm him. Doga and Unei remained to fend the entity off as G'raha returned to Eorzea to end Xande's covenant with the Cloud. During the Scions' travel to the Void sometime later, they and the Warrior are assured by Zero that the Cloud would not not likely be fully restored as she lost the vast amounts of voidsent she had consumed over the years and may have likely been devoured in her weakened state by another.
